ModMetaData.name: Cruesoe's Fixes
ModMetaData.author: crues
ModMetaData.description:
Catch-all mod for small personal tweaks and compatibility fixes. Each fix lives in its own conditionally-loaded folder under "Mods and Shit", so it only applies when its target mod is active.
Fixes included: - Combat Extended Guns: files the CE Artillery Howitzer under the Ferny_Weapons designation category added by Better Architect Menu, instead of its default category.
(New fixes are appended to this list as they're added - see the repo's "Mods and Shit" folder for the full set.)
